title: AI Phishing Triage & Auto-Purge (O365/Google Workspace)
goal: Integrate directly with enterprise email systems. When an employee reports an email, AegisPT autonomously analyzes the headers, attachments, and links, and if proven malicious, auto-purges the email from all other employee inboxes.
scope: Mail API integrations (Graph API / Gmail API), Email parsing logic, and automated remediation action engine.
generation_reason: Dramatically reduce the load on the SOC team and limit the exposure time of phishing campaigns.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Auto-purge requires explicit tenant-level opt-in. Default to alert-only mode.

success_criteria: AegisPT can ingest a .eml file or webhook from O365.
AI correctly identifies the threat vector using the sandbox.
System successfully issues a delete/quarantine command to the mail provider.

acceptance_criteria: Email parsing and API deletion calls are correctly formatted and tested against mocked providers.

out_of_scope: Acting as an inline MTA (Mail Transfer Agent)
